title: Reviewed Pricing Rules with Bounded Rework
promptSingle: Implement the pricing package according to the docstrings. Implement apply_discount in pricing/calculator.py with Decimal-safe cent rounding, validation of non-negative amount and a rate in [0, 1], and summarize in pricing/summary.py without changing public signatures. Run the visible tests before finishing.

roles.prompt: Implement ONLY pricing/calculator.py according to its docstrings. Use Decimal or an equivalent exact cent calculation, reject negative amounts and rates outside [0, 1], and preserve the public signature. Do not edit pricing/summary.py. Run the visible tests if useful.

Act as an independent reviewer for pricing/calculator.py. Implement or correct the calculator in that file so its docstring and boundary behavior are satisfied, including exact cent rounding and invalid input rejection. Do not edit pricing/summary.py. Treat the starter file as the review baseline and leave a complete implementation.
Implement ONLY pricing/summary.py according to its docstrings. Do not edit pricing/calculator.py. Keep the function signatures unchanged and ensure empty inputs and Decimal cent values are handled.

reconcilerPrompt: Reconcile the immutable pricing_impl and pricing_reviewer changes to pricing/calculator.py, and preserve the summary_impl change. Produce a clean implementation satisfying all docstrings and visible tests; do not silently discard a valid boundary fix.
